title: Recorded measurement trends
responsibility: Builds source-size, complexity and dependency trends while keeping benchmark profiles separate.

inputs.name: harnessGrowth.index
inputs.description: Index holding unit growth and revision order.

inputs.name: unitTimings.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose benchmark entries are requested.

outputs.name: growthMetrics
outputs.description: The source-bytes, complexity and dependencies metric keys.

outputs.name: harnessGrowth
outputs.description: Oldest-first growth rows with values, notes and differences from the immediately preceding growth point when both values exist. Missing metrics stay undefined; changed is true only for a nonzero numeric delta.

outputs.name: unitTimings
outputs.description: Matching benchmark entries unchanged, preserving their independent series.

outputs.name: signed
outputs.description: Empty for zero, undefined or other falsy numeric values; a plus sign for positive differences, otherwise the numeric string.
